description: Retrieves a bounded native semantic DOM frame graph, including accessible iframe documents, for tag hierarchy, bounds, Shadow DOM, and selector diagnostics; use DOM.getAXTree as the default page map first.

pageId.description: Page ID whose DOM structure should be inspected.

id.description: Canonical element ID to inspect from DOM.getAXTree.

selector.description: Unique CSS selector used to resolve the semantic tree root.

includeShadowDom.description: Include Shadow DOM content in the returned tree when true.

filterNoise.description: Filter low-signal nodes from the returned tree when true.

purpose.description: Describe why raw local DOM structure is needed, e.g., diagnosing a selector, inspecting Shadow DOM, bounds, or nested layout after DOM.getAXTree was insufficient
